The '''Pyrewood Leatherworker''' is a [[human]] [[leather]] [[armor]] [[vendor]] found in her house left of the Pyrewood Inn entrance in [[Pyrewood Village]] in [[Silverpine Forest]]. At night, she transforms into her [[worgen]] form as the '''[[Moonrage Leatherworker]]'''.

==Notes==
*She is affiliated with [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] during the daytime to make her unattackable by Alliance players.
